exclusions: unverified blog reposts without original citations
full-text claims when only abstract or metadata was inspected
external satellite imagery download catalogs (violates R04)
unpinned community repos with incompatible licenses for baseline runtime

domains.name: ENVI结构与调用
research_questions: How do ENVI 5.6 Task Engine (ENVITask / taskengine.exe) and ENVI Classic differ in parameter schema and invocation?
Which classification and post-processing tasks are natively exposed in ENVI 5.6, and how are .dat/.hdr outputs paired?
Why do ENVI Classic GUI dialogs occasionally drop rapid keyboard inputs, and how must effective_parameters be verified?

domains.name: MATLAB结构与调用
research_questions: What are the Python version and toolbox constraints for MATLAB R2022a (9.12.0.1884302) on the user's Windows 11 host?
How do we implement Maximum Likelihood, K-Means++, ISODATA, PCA, and morphological post-processing in base MATLAB R2022a when Statistics/Image/Mapping Toolboxes are absent?
How are random seeds, array dimensions (H x W x B vs N x B), and session locks managed via MATLAB MCP Server or Engine API?

domains.name: ArcGIS Pro结构与调用
research_questions: How does the isolated ArcGIS Pro 3.6 (ArcInfo + Spatial/ImageAnalyst) Python worker validate extension availability before running raster tools?
Why do ArcGISProject.activeMap and activeView return None in headless scripts, and how do we verify .aprx broken data sources?
How must categorical vs continuous rasters configure resampling_type, snapRaster, extent, and cellSize in ArcPy?

domains.name: 数据与物理量
research_questions: When can Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 Surface Reflectance scale factors (0.0000275 * DN - 0.2) be applied vs keeping raw storage byte values?
How should unreferenced rasters (such as Canon City can_tmr.img lacking map info/CRS) represent pixel coordinates and area units?
How is the 6-band TM order (b1..b6 = TM1, TM2, TM3, TM4, TM5, TM7) mapped to spectral wavelengths?

domains.name: 基础处理与指数
research_questions: What float casting, zero-denominator masking (-9999), and band mappings are required for NDVI, NDWI, MNDWI, and Tasseled Cap (K-T) transforms?
Why must the Landsat 5 TM Tasseled Cap 3rd component be termed 'wetness-related third component (Third)' rather than directly 'Wetness'?
How must PCA standardize bands and isolate its fitting sample set from validation buffers?

domains.name: 分类与后处理
research_questions: What are the mathematical assumptions, covariance regularization, and prior settings for Maximum Likelihood and Parallelepiped classification?
How do ISODATA split/merge thresholds work, and why must untriggered split/merge branches be distinguished from verified branches?
How do Majority, Sieve, and Clump post-processing affect narrow water bodies, and how do native ENVI vs morphological approximations differ?

domains.name: 评价与空间统计
research_questions: How are Producer's Accuracy (PA), User's Accuracy (UA), Overall Accuracy (OA), Kappa, and unclassified rate defined on an asymmetric confusion matrix?
What distinguishes diagnostic re-evaluation (MATLAB 73.50%), visual reference ROI agreement (ENVI 43.50%), and independent probability-sampled accuracy (Olofsson et al. 2014)?
How does Chebyshev spatial buffer checking (Roberts et al. 2017) prevent spatial autocorrelation leakage between training and test ROIs?

domains.name: 工程、桌面截图与开源组件
research_questions: How do desktop_lock, window title/PID verification, and displayed_artifact_sha256 prevent stale or occluded window screenshots?
What are the Windows session limits of pywinauto (locked screen / disconnected RDP) and how should the coordinator block rather than fake screenshots?
